criteria.label: Dates and deadlines
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Every date and every deadline needs a place in the source. If it says “open” there, it stays open.

criteria.label: Numbers and amounts
criteria.ruleOfThumb: An exact number is only right if the same number is in the source.

criteria.label: Decisions and status
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Watch out for “approved” or “decided”. Was it still open in the source?

criteria.label: People and responsibilities
criteria.ruleOfThumb: For every task, check whether the same person is named next to it in the source.

criteria.label: Conditions
criteria.ruleOfThumb: An “if” or “provided that” must not disappear.

criteria.label: Check the source
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Ask for every claim: where does it come from, and can I open the source myself?

suggestions: I summarise meetings with AI and don't want to send out made-up dates
I read a lot of reports and want to check numbers against the source quickly
I do research for work and want to know which details I can trust
mission.default: I want to check AI summaries against the source with confidence.

criteria.label: What is done
criteria.ruleOfThumb: First say what is finished and where it is.

criteria.label: What is open
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Open points belong in the message, explicitly.

criteria.label: Who is involved
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Every open item needs a name.

criteria.label: Dates
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Give fixed appointments with a date.

criteria.label: Tone and clarity
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Stay factual, state your request in the first sentence, offer a next step.

suggestions: I write status updates for the team and want nothing to get lost
I hand work over to colleagues and want to say clearly what is open
I answer customers by email and want to stay friendly and clear
mission.default: I want to write messages in which the status, open points and dates are clear.

criteria.label: Who it is for
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Tell the AI who will read the result.

criteria.label: Length and format
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Set the length and form, for example “at most five bullet points”.

criteria.label: What must be in it
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Name the details that must not be missing.

criteria.label: Handling missing details
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Say what the AI should do when something is missing: mark it as open, don't make it up.

criteria.label: Check the result
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Compare the result with your instructions point by point.

suggestions: I let the AI write meeting minutes and want usable results
I write texts for customers and want to give the AI clear briefs
I make presentations and want to prepare content faster with AI
mission.default: I want to give the AI briefs that lead to the result I want.

criteria.label: Sender address
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Look at the domain after the @, not at the display name.

criteria.label: Time pressure and threats
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Pressure like “locked in 24 hours” is meant to stop you from checking.

criteria.label: Impersonal greeting
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Real customer emails usually use your name.

criteria.label: Link target
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Before you click, check where the link really goes.

criteria.label: Website address
criteria.ruleOfThumb: What counts is the part right before the ending.

criteria.label: Requests for sensitive data
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Never enter a password or card details through a link from an email.

suggestions: I answer customer emails and want to recognise phishing reliably
I use e-banking and want to recognise fake login pages
I often get parcel text messages and want to know which ones are real
mission.default: I want to recognise phishing emails and fake websites reliably.

criteria.label: What you did
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Describe the steps that led to the error.

criteria.label: Exact error message
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Copy the error message exactly, with its code.

criteria.label: What you expected
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Say what should actually have happened.

criteria.label: What you already tried
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Name what you have already tried.

criteria.label: Device and program
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Browser, device and program belong in every report.

criteria.label: Clarify the requirements
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Before you choose a tool: what must it do, for whom, with which data?

suggestions: I report IT problems and want support to be able to help quickly
I choose new tools for the team and want to clarify the requirements
I help colleagues with computer problems and want to work in a structured way
mission.default: I want to describe technical problems so that others can help quickly.

criteria.label: Slope of the tangent
criteria.ruleOfThumb: The derivative at a point is the slope of the tangent there.

criteria.label: Secant becomes tangent
criteria.ruleOfThumb: As the second point moves closer and closer, the secant becomes the tangent.

suggestions: I am preparing for an exam and want to understand derivatives
I want to interpret rates of change correctly at work
I help my child with maths homework
mission.default: I want to understand what a derivative means.

criteria.label: Mass and fall time
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Without air, all bodies fall equally fast, regardless of their mass.

criteria.label: Air resistance
criteria.ruleOfThumb: Differences in falling come from air resistance, not from weight.

suggestions: I want to explain everyday observations about falling correctly
I am preparing for a physics exam
I want to explain to my child why everything falls at the same speed
mission.default: I want to understand what the fall time depends on.
